notes.title: Steam Autumn Sale + Merchandise Store Launch
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5032795/a64152111f355d4b458408ac30f0d63fdaa9d22d.png

Hello,

The Steam Autumn Sale is now live and Paws is 75% off. What better time to jump in, embrace your best animal self and make furry friends?

We’re also ecstatic to finally be able to say that our very own merchandise store is now live and operational. This is the first time we’ve been able to offer premium quality items with Might and Delight prints but it’s been highly requested by fans for a long while now. 

Click here to visit the store page.

On day one we offer a selection of t-shirts, tote bags and mugs - but we have mouse mats and notebooks on the way, and we’re going to listen closely to what our community would like us to expand our assortment with. The t-shirts currently on offer are labelled “First Edition” on the neck tag and there are only 1000 of them available for now. We might not produce these particular prints again once they’re gone, so don’t miss out! 

With that we wish you a very pleasant day and holiday season. Talk to you again soon!

Best wishes, 
Oliver & the team at Might and Delight

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5032795/e40e3f549823e8b5b15ef7735727071f7d6a4ca6.png

notes.title: We celebrate the Book of Travels EA with a Launch Bundle – save up to 70%!
notes.content:
Hello!

Might And Delight are thrilled about finally having launched Book of Travels into Early Access! This is the start of a new world that we'll be building together with players, and by way of a launch trailer, artist Lotta gives an overview of the phases of development that will come next in this video. We hope you like what you see!

[previewyoutube=D6UFUUvWzUA;full][/previewyoutube]

Take advantage of the Early Access Launch Sale and get Book of Travels for 10% off! 
(Sale ends Monday, October 18th, 10 am PT.) 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1152340/Book_of_Travels/

Celebrate with a beautiful bundle!

To celebrate the launch of our TMORPG Book of Travels we've put a beautifully packaged bundle of Might and Delight treats. We hope you agree that this array of goods comes at a really appealing price and will give you any extra incentive you need to get on board and support Book of Travels in its fledgling week.

Save up to 70% (the discount may differ depending on what games and DLCs you already own)!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/23065/Book_of_Travels_EA_Launch_Bundle__10_Games__16_DLCs/

The Book of Travels Early Access Launch Bundle and Sale ends after this weekend, so don’t snooze!
 
Thanks for keeping your eyes on our games and our studio here on Steam! If you've missed out on any or all of our journey to this audacious moment, please take a little peek at our blogs and videos on our news page – we'd love to have you with us on this great adventure!

Best Wishes,

Helen & The Dev Team

notes.title: OUT NOW - Shelter 3
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34813752/06457db05679546b95102ab752fb50d2b03249cb.png

Hello!
Today is the day that Shelter 3 goes live and we wanted to reach out to you and let you know about our sale, which comes with an extra 10% discount for those of you who already own a Shelter product. But, sales aside we are also here to share our launch trailer which we think gives the best flavour yet of how it will be to guide those elephants. 

It will be hard. 
Your path will be treacherous. 
Your babies will need you. 

[previewyoutube=U_IlNFERdzE;full][/previewyoutube]

For a limited 24 hour period we are also reducing two of our favourite bundles (the M&D bundle and Shelter bundle - which means that you can get a whole lot of Shelter for less than 70% - including Shelter 3! (The cost of any games you already own will be discounted from the final price.) 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34813752/e520bb8a3e7293a795eb6e4095d848462d83c14b.png

We’d love to hear all your thoughts on Shelter 3 – it’s definitely something a little different from its predecessors and we’re curious to know what kind of emotions we’ll be reading from you in just a few hours! Of course we’d love to hear your comments and reviews, so please do stay in touch with us right here on Steam or on Facebook or Twitter (buttons below). We’ll be responding as fast as we can throughout the launch period. 

We’ll also be speaking to devs live on our Youtube channel at around 7pm CET or check out the video if you miss us. 

Thank you from our hearts for being here with us on this third part of the Shelter journey. We humbly await your reception.

Best Wishes,

Helen & the Dev Team

notes.title: New Statues in Meadow
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32963958/2beee0f2bf3c57f13e30ef963fd7f01bb1eb8adb.png

Hello!

Following the brilliant turnout for our Meadow birthday party last month we've been listening to your feedback and made some plans for more statues and achievements. That's right, the fun will go on! Only this time the statues will stay for good, which is just as well because they're not easy to spot!

Every Month a Creature

For each month until the release of Shelter 3 next year, we'll be placing ten statues of an animal from Shelter 3 in the Meadow world. That's nine more animals altogether and we're going to reveal them one by teasey one as the months roll by ;) As with the anniversary elephants, you'll unlock achievements for the first, fifth and tenth statues you find.

Spot the Crocs!

Next you'll be able to hunt low slung crocs across the game world - check them out on podium number two and keep your eyes peeled! We hope you enjoy seeking them out and showing the way and sharing your findings, and best of all, there is absolutely no rush.

We hope you like the crocs! See you in the Meadow!

Best Wishes and stay connected,

Helen and the Shelter Team xx

notes.title: Thank you for Fantastic Anniversary! + New Statue Hunts
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32963958/4eda724f77e08740febf90b174f38c105d3434cb.jpg

Hello!


A great big thank you to all of you who shared and played our Anniversary Play Event last weekend: we broke our 10k player target and raised a welcome donation for Safe in Our World. We saw lots of you sharing the event on your social channels and some of you helping newbies around the place, and we do appreciate that for a fair few of you the Meadow was a little more crowded than you're used to - so thanks for sharing your space for the party <3 


Elephants return

We're glad you enjoyed helping one another visit them all, and we've heard that many of you don't feel super keen on time limited achievements, so we'll be putting them back for another ten days, which we hope will be enough time for new players to find them all and will allow previous ones to finish up. Expect to see them some time on May 5th. We might add a few extra too, more info on that next week. You'll get achievements for the first, fifth and tenth elephant that you visit.

More Shelter 3 statues to come...

The elephants were so popular that we thought we'd make some more statues for you to find, so in the next couple of months we'll be dropping a different kind of animal in for another ten days. Every animal will be from Shelter 3, and our first new animal will be appearing in June.

We hope this is good news for you and thanks again for a really great super feel good anniversary weekend!

Best Wishes and Stay Safe!

Helen and the Team

notes.title: Free Weekend of Meadow + Charity Play Event for our Tenth Anniversary
notes.content:
Hello!

About this time in April ten years ago, Might and Delight was made, and to celebrate suitably in these times of lockdown we're holding a great big Meadow play event. For the duration of the play event all profit from our Steam sales will go to charity Safe in Our World, and if we get 10,000 players joining us in #Meadow we'll add 25% to that donation - so please join us, bring your friends along... and help us get to 10,000 players by sharing the event on Twitter and beyond!

ADDITIONAL NEWS! Meadow will be free to play all weekend, so please share this news and invite your friends and family to join in too!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32963958/05cd39ac9dab825c61c1f40cb667807bc4195440.jpg


Safe in our World’s mission is to create and foster worldwide mental health awareness within the video game industry and beyond. Founded by industry veterans in 2019, the charity is currently working to promote positive mental health in the Covid-19 crisis - you can read more about their work here.

The event begins on Thursday April 23rd and will end at midnight on Sunday 25th. As well as obelisks to unlock together, there will be some special edition statues of elephants to find, which will gain achievements. 

Details

 #PlayApartTogether Event in Meadow
 Starts 10 am PST Thursday 23rd April, ends Sunday 26th
 All profit from sales of M&D games over the duration go to Safe in Our World
 An extra 25% will be added if 10,000 players attend
 Spot 10 new hidden elephant statues to unlock achievements and look out for the devs in their special dev skins!
 Find your new playmates on Discord during and after the adventure (#Meadow or #Play-With-The-Devs)


Thank you so much for your support through the years - we're so glad to have had you with us and we look forward to all we can create together in the years to come! 

Stay safe and be well,

Helen and the team xx

notes.title: Update - Tobii Eye Tracking
notes.content:
There is now support for Tobii Eye Tracking!

Features

 Move the camera with extended view – the camera will turn where your eyes and head move.
 Sense footsteps – extend your senses, and footsteps will light up when you look at them.


Do note that for now, eye tracking only works on Windows.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11616331/bfe5a76dd1caa94e00c981084d31177750e352f1.jpg

notes.title: Patch 2016-04-05
notes.content:
Save file problem caused by the 04-01 patch solved.


If you have played on a save since the last patch and exited to the main menu, you will not be able to load it. This will not happen again with the patch, but it doesn't fix the save files.

We are very sorry this happened. 
If you have a save file you want fixed, send it to us at beef@mightanddelight.com with "Bug: Save File" in the topic, together with which level each save slot should load.
